top_comments.author: werdnum
top_comments.body:
This has suddenly started happening VERY often, and repeatedly - appears to be related to 2.0.10.

Previously it was only happening with a Stop hook, and I hadn't seen it in ~a week after enabling the Stop hook. In the last couple of hours my instance has upgraded itself to 2.0.10 and I have two conversations where this is happening repeatedly, even after I rewind and start again, it will run for a few minutes and then get stuck once more.

top_comments.author: macOS26
top_comments.body: Today is the first time I encountered it. The only fix was switch to Opus. Unfortunately, Opus access runs out in less than an hour of use and weekly limits get reached much quicker as well. So if it’s a Sonnet 4.5 bug, and you are out of Opus access, you can get stuck.Access for the past week has been up and down like a yoyo. I was on the most expensive plan, but due to the API errors I went to the middle plan and contemplating going to the Pro plan, the least expensive plan, and use it less. W
